title: Grateful Dead Live at Hampton Coliseum on 1988-03-28
lineage: TDK MAX Masters > Nakamichi DR-3 > Vdh First Ultimate Audiophile cables > Apogee MiniMe (16/44.1) > EGOSYS WT2496 (soundcard) > SoundForge 7 > CDWAVE 1.93.3 > FLAC frontend 1.7.1
source: in house FM > unknown receiver > Sony TCD5M > Sony WM-D6C TDK MA-X master cassettes

ai_review.summary: Crispy, high‑energy set with sparkling Stranger, Franklin's Tower, Bird Song, Truckin', Dark Star and The Other One, though marred by noticeable static.
ai_review.review: The performance shines on tracks like Stranger, Franklin's Tower, Bird Song and the seamless Truckin' → Dark Star → Other One sequence, earning high praise from reviewers. Recording quality is generally crisp, but persistent static noise detracts from an otherwise clean capture.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewer gave 4 stars, highlighted many standout songs, and only noted static as a drawback; limited data (single review) leads to low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Static noise is problematic, but overall the sound is crisp and clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong flow with a highlighted Truckin' → Dark Star → Other One sequence and consistent sparkle throughout the set.
